parameters.why: Asymmetric delay times create rhythmic complexity and movement
High feedback creates evolving, self-generating textures
Pitch modulation creates detuning and warbling
Slow modulation creates evolving rather than static repeats
Filtered repeats create darkening echo decay

why: Psychedelic sound design relies on time-based effects (delay, reverb) with high feedback, pitch modulation for warbling/detuning, and filtering that darkens repeats over time.

anti_patterns.reason: Creates static stereo effect without the evolving quality
